name: Rajasekar C
title: Data Engineer | Product Engineer | Founder
summary: Data and backend engineer with 5+ years building high-volume production systems. Deep in SQL, Python, PostgreSQL, and ETL, with a proven track record in data engineering and backend engineering at scale (~50M records/day). Now focused on independent product development, shipping software end to end.

bullets: Design and build software products end to end, owning system architecture, backend, and deployment
Build backend services and REST APIs on PostgreSQL and Redis, adding caching and automated background jobs for reliability
Containerize and ship services with Docker, managing source, releases, and CI-style workflows through Git and GitHub
Automate data indexing, metadata handling, and operational tasks to cut manual effort and keep systems consistent
Use AI-assisted development (Cursor, Claude, Codex) to accelerate build-test-iterate cycles and ship product improvements continuously
Built a Flask and Pandas tool that cut Vahan issue resolution from ~30 minutes to under 1 minute, winning the company "Tech Titan" award
Designed and operated ETL pipelines processing ~50M records/day, keeping downstream reporting accurate and on time
Automated MoEngage customer notifications with real-time stored procedures for policy-renewal detection, removing redundant alerts
Versioned PostgreSQL schemas by extracting DDL into Git, making deployments traceable, reviewable, and reproducible
Implemented PII classification and secure credential storage to keep data handling compliant
Delivered ETL pipelines and schemas for the Bima Satrak regulatory reporting service
Resolved 4000+ production issues, cutting the open backlog from ~600 to under 70
Automated recurring credit-update and Excel-to-database ingestion with SQL and Pandas, replacing manual runs
Built Oracle SQL and PL/SQL solutions, including queries, stored procedures, and reports, for banking and insurance clients
Provided production support for live banking and insurance systems, owning incident response and root-cause analysis
Optimized database performance by tuning slow queries and stored procedures under high-usage workloads
Managed deployments and database maintenance and recovery across client production environments
Founded and ran a construction business delivering residential and commercial projects end to end
Managed vendors, clients, budgets, and schedules across concurrent projects
Led site teams and daily operations, owning quality and on-time delivery
